# Google Calendar Trigger

## Summary

Learn how to use the Google Calendar Trigger node in n8n.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/trigger-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.googlecalendartrigger.md

---

Learn how to use the Google Calendar Trigger node in n8n. Follow technical documentation to integrate Google Calendar Trigger node into your workflows.

[Google Calendar](https://www.google.com/calendar/) is a time-management and scheduling calendar service developed by Google.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Credentials**

Refer to the [Google credentials documentation](/integrations/builtin/credentials/google) for authentication information for this node.
{% endhint %}

{% hint style="info" %}
**Examples and templates**

For usage examples and templates to help you get started, refer to n8n's [Google Calendar Trigger integrations](https://n8n.io/integrations/google-calendar-trigger/) page.
{% endhint %}
